Issued to:
Damietta Combined Cycle Power Station

This document explains the steps of the weekly inspection of the fire water pumps. The fire water network is fed by three pumps: the first is the jockey pump, which compensates for leaks in the fire line and maintains the fire network pressure within the normal limits. The second is the electric fire pump, which is the main fire pump and operates when the fire systems are activated or the fire hydrants are opened. The third is the diesel pump, which operates if the main pump fails. This document was prepared by Eng. Yousry Abdel Halim Abdel Latif and tested by Eng. Wasfy William Nashed - Senior Engineer, Occupational Safety and Health Department - and approved by Eng. Ahmed El-Husseiny Abdullah, General Manager. It was reviewed by Chemist Ahmed El-Sayed Ibrahim and Eng. Soliman Zaki Soliman, General Manager of Quality Assurance and Quality Control, and approved by Eng. Mohamed Mohamed Farag Anan - Head of the Damietta Power Generation Station Sector - and Eng. Mohamed Hussein Gomaa, Head of the Quality Assurance and Quality Control Sector at the East Delta Electricity Production Company.
Issue the work order from the Occupational Safety and Health Department
No special tools are needed during the inspection rounds
Check that there are no oil, fuel or water leaks
Check the cleanliness and that there is no waste around the pump
Check that there is no corrosion in all pump parts
Check that there are no loud or abnormal sounds while the pumps are running
Check that there is no vibration on the pumps
Check the diesel lubricating oil level
Check the cleanliness of the fire diesel batteries and the tightness of the electrical connections
Check the operation of the diesel enclosure and diesel room ventilation fans
Check that the pump starting switch is in the automatic position
Check the tightness of all pump parts
Check the gland cooling water pressure so that it is in a suitable quantity
Check the correct tension of the diesel pump belts and that they are not damaged
Check that the ball bearing temperature is within the normal limits
Check the operation of the diesel engine cooling water heater
Check the cleanliness of the air filter and the diesel fuel filter
Check that the diesel fuel tank is full and drain any water in the tank
Check the acid solution level in the batteries
During the weekly operation, check the soundness of the diesel oil pressure and fuel pressure and the soundness of all gauges and operating indicators
